criteria.question: Is the patient 18 to under 80 years old?
criteria.original_text: Participant must be 18-<80 years of age at the time of signing the informed consent.

criteria.question: Has the patient had an active asthma diagnosis for at least 6 months?
criteria.original_text: Physician diagnosis of asthma (according to GINA 2025) for ≥6 months

criteria.question: Is historical airflow variability documented (positive reversibility, FEV1 variability between visits, positive bronchial challenge, or peak flow variability over 20%)?
criteria.original_text: with documented historical airflow variability by one of the following: Positive reversibility test: ≥12% and 200 ml in FEV1 after SABA administration at any point prior to randomisation; Airflow variability in clinic FEV1 >12% and 200 mL between historical clinical visits; Positive bronchial challenge test; Peak flow variability of >20% between two assessments

criteria.question: At screening, are blood eosinophils at least 0.3 x 10^9/L and FeNO at least 35 ppb?
criteria.original_text: Evidence of elevated type-2 biomarkers defined as both of: peripheral BEC ≥ 0.3×109/L at screening visit; FeNO ≥ 35 ppb at screening visit

criteria.question: In the last 2 years, did the patient have an asthma attack treated with oral or injected steroids for 3+ days, or an emergency or hospital visit for asthma?
criteria.original_text: At least 1 asthma attack in the last 2 years, defined as acute asthma requiring SCS for ≥ 3 days or an emergency/hospital visit requiring SCS.

criteria.question: Has the patient been on a medium or high dose inhaled corticosteroid (over 250 mcg/day fluticasone propionate or equivalent) for at least 3 months?
criteria.original_text: Treatment and evident adherence to a stable at-least medium-dose ICS (fluticasone propionate equivalent >250 mcg/day) for at least 3 months (including run-in period) [additional controllers e.g. LABA, LAMA or LTA are allowed].

criteria.question: Is the ACQ-5 asthma control score 1.5 or higher?
criteria.original_text: uncontrolled asthma symptoms indicated by ACQ5 score of ≥ 1.5

criteria.question: Is post-bronchodilator FEV1 80% of predicted or lower?
criteria.original_text: impaired lung function indicated by post-bronchodilator FEV1 of ≤ 80% predicted

criteria.question: Is the patient on high-dose maintenance inhaled corticosteroid (over 500 mcg/day fluticasone propionate or equivalent)?
criteria.original_text: high-dose maintenance ICS therapy

criteria.question: Did the patient have a severe asthma attack between 1 and 12 months ago?
criteria.original_text: severe asthma attack in past 1-<12 months

criteria.question: Is she not pregnant or breastfeeding, and either not of childbearing potential or willing to use highly effective contraception, with a negative pregnancy test?
criteria.original_text: Female participants: not pregnant or breastfeeding, and is a woman of nonchildbearing potential or a WOCBP who agrees to use a highly effective contraceptive method; negative pregnancy test at screening and Day 1.

criteria.question: Can the patient give signed informed consent and comply with the protocol?
criteria.original_text: Capable of giving signed informed consent which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the informed consent form (ICF) and in this protocol.

criteria.question: Has the patient taken oral or injected steroids in the last month, or are they on maintenance oral steroids?
criteria.original_text: Use of SCS < 1 months prior to screening or on maintenance SCS.

criteria.question: Does the patient currently smoke, or did they quit less than 6 months ago?
criteria.original_text: Current tobacco smoker or recently stopped smoker (<6 months)

criteria.question: Is the patient an ex-smoker with over 10 pack-years and a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC below the lower limit of normal?
criteria.original_text: Ex-smoker with greater than 10 pack-years AND post bronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio below the lower limit of normal according to GLI race-neutral standards.

criteria.question: Do pharmacy refill records show less than 75% of the prescribed inhaled steroid dispensed over the past 12 months?
criteria.original_text: Documented nonadherence to ICS, defined as dispensing of less than 75% of the prescribed ICS dose over the past 12 months, based on pharmacy refill records checked at screening.

criteria.question: Does the patient have uncorrectable inhaler technique problems at screening?
criteria.original_text: Presence of significant and uncorrectable inhaler technique deficiencies, as assessed by the research team during inhaler technique evaluation at screening.

criteria.question: Does the patient have a contraindication to dupilumab?
criteria.original_text: Contra-indication to study drug

criteria.question: In the investigator's view, does an immune disease, condition or medication affect the patient's inflammatory response?
criteria.original_text: Immunological disease, condition or medication that may affect the inflammatory response according to Investigator.

criteria.question: Does the patient have another significant lung disease: COPD, lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, bronchiectasis or Churg-Strauss?
criteria.original_text: History of other significant lung disease e.g. lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, clinically significant bronchiectasis, chronic obstructive lung disease, or Churg-Strauss.

criteria.question: In the investigator's view, does a severe concomitant illness, including immunodeficiency, affect participation?
criteria.original_text: Severe concomitant illness (including known or suspected immunodeficiency) that, in the Investigator's judgement will adversely affect the participant's participation in the study.

criteria.question: Does the patient have active cancer or a cancer in the last 5 years, other than basal cell skin cancer or fully resected cervical dysplasia?
criteria.original_text: Active malignancy or history of malignancy within 5 years (except for basal cell carcinoma of the skin or fully resected Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia/dysplasia).

criteria.question: Has the patient recently had a monoclonal antibody for asthma (dupilumab, omalizumab, mepolizumab, benralizumab, reslizumab, tezepelumab) or an investigational drug?
criteria.original_text: Exposure to monoclonal antibody therapy for asthma or another investigational medicinal product within 5 half-lives of the drug.

criteria.question: Does the patient have nasal polyps, atopic dermatitis, eosinophilic esophagitis or prurigo nodularis?
criteria.original_text: Eligibility to Dupilumab based on licensed and reimbursed indications in the participant's jurisdiction (e.g. nasal polyposis, atopic dermatitis, eosinophilic esophagitis, prurigo nodularis, etc.)

criteria.question: Did the patient get a live vaccine in the last 4 weeks?
criteria.original_text: Treatment with live (attenuated) vaccine in the past 4 weeks.

criteria.question: Is the patient taking a medication the protocol prohibits?
criteria.original_text: Prohibited medication

criteria.question: Does the patient have a current helminth (parasitic worm) infection?
criteria.original_text: Current helminth infection
